<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..40,300;0,9..40,400;0,9..40,500;1,9..40,400&display=swap');

*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

body {

.portfolio-shell { display: flex; height: 100vh; overflow: hidden; align-items: stretch; }

.sidebar {

.sidebar-photo { width: 180px; height: 180px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center 20%; border: 2px solid #2a2a2a; margin: 0 auto 2rem; display: block; }

.timeline-wrapper { margin-top: 0.5rem; }

.timeline-wrapper table { font-size: 14px !important; width: 100%; table-layout: fixed; line-height: 1.5; color: #444; border-collapse: collapse; }

.timeline-wrapper td:nth-child(1), .timeline-wrapper th:nth-child(1) { width: 72%; }
.timeline-wrapper td:nth-child(2), .timeline-wrapper th:nth-child(2) { width: 28%; }

.timeline-wrapper th { text-align: left !important; color: #111; font-size: 14px !important; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.8px; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 11px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e8e8e8; }

.timeline-wrapper table tbody tr { background-color: transparent !important; }

.timeline-wrapper table tbody tr:nth-child(odd), .timeline-wrapper table tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background-color: transparent !important; }

.menu-toggle { display: none; }

@media (max-width: 768px) {

      <div class="body-col">
        I am passionate about higher education and the difference data can make in how it operates. My goal is to bring analytical rigor and clear data visualization to the departments and teams I work with, whether that is within the UC, CSU, or community college systems. I want to be the analyst who strengthens how these teams understand their own operations, so that the improvements ripple outward and change the institution their students experience.

Looking ahead, I hope to grow into a Senior Financial or Budget Analyst role within a higher education institution, and further down the road, I am open to either continuing on toward a Finance Director role or pivoting into local government.
